description: Sirikaro-shape case (issue #625): a 5-item list where every item passes the item-level match_threshold (per-item score = 0.5, exactly at cutoff) but 4 of the 10 leaves inside are wrong. Under v0.6.3–v0.6.5 semantics: parent Items shows ✓ while drilldown shows Items[1..4].name ✗ — self-contradictory. Under v2.0 (row-level derivation from field_comparisons): parent = ✗, section precision reflects the leaf failures. Pinning this shape prevents regressions to either of Stickler's two rollup views (cm.overall or cm.aggregate) that miss this case.

Items.description: 5-item list — every item Hungarian-paired, 4 name leaves wrong
